## New API submission

**API name:**

**Category:** (inference / embeddings / image-gen / speech / code / multimodal / vision)

**Free tier available?** Yes / No

**Checklist:**
- [ ] Added entry to `data/apis.json` with all required fields (id, name, description, url, docsUrl, category, models, freeTier, auth, status, tags)
- [ ] Snippets field is either filled in or left as empty strings (maintainer will generate them)
- [ ] `id` field is lowercase kebab-case, unique, matches no existing entry
- [ ] Description is one or two plain sentences, no marketing fluff
- [ ] Tested that the URL is reachable
